title: Forward walk · alternating support
source_label: SOURCE LOOKUP · walk T0 / A0 · exact phases 0–7
observed: Eight distinct poses already exchange the apparent advancing leg. A still strip cannot establish world-space planting.
proposal: Keep the eight-phase distance clock. Make the supporting sole flat, the passing toe visibly lifted, and the two anatomical feet distinguishable without debug color.
native_review: Observe at 1x before enlarging. Do not call a moving foot planted just because it is the lowest pixel.
runtime_gate: Measure realized ground displacement and sole samples over two cycles; repeat blocked, stopping, turning and walk-to-sprint.

title: True diagonal slide · travel NE / aim S
source_label: SOURCE LOOKUP · slide T3 / A0 · phase ignored by this presenter
observed: The source has a real NE slide drawing, but selection uses aim, not travel. This probe therefore repeats the S slide cell, even while travel is NE.
proposal: Author contact and recline along actual NE travel with head/chest/pelvis yaw still S. Slide soles glide; they must not be labeled alternating walk plants.
native_review: Look for a recognizable travel axis without relying on arrows, a skid particle trail or a rotated South bitmap.
runtime_gate: Actual diagonal admission, momentum, brake, exit, wall contact and all 64 travel/aim pairs need the missing caller and live captures.

title: Backpedal · travel N / aim S
source_label: SOURCE LOOKUP · walk T4 / A0 · distinct from forward bank
observed: A separate backward travel/forward aim sequence already exists. It is not an absent feature or merely the forward strip played backward.
proposal: Keep face and ready hands on S. Use a clear rearward placement, low passing toe and alternating support; no 180-degree waist twist.
native_review: The viewer should identify travel as N with the direction arrows hidden, while identifying aim as S.
runtime_gate: Repeat with rapid aim reversal, actual deceleration through zero, collision and the back-diagonal neighbors.

title: Strafe while casting · travel N / aim E
source_label: GAIT-ONLY PROBE · T4 / A2 · not a replay of live cast routing
observed: The checkpoint says moving casts retain gait legs without a new arm layer. Direct frame("cast", ...) instead selects a static base cell. The caller resolving these choices is absent.
proposal: Preserve gait phase while an admitted hand action reads startup, release and recovery. Current body aim turns immediately; a committed shot keeps its recorded start aim.
native_review: The arm extension must be readable at 1x without glow. Release a hand pose on the release event, not merely when a locomotion phase number is reached.
runtime_gate: Admitted/refused cast, release while turning, repeated Rapid casts, all four families, interruption and frame-rate changes; no restart of feet.
asterisk: The eight displayed labels are a storyboard sample, not an action-to-gait phase coupling or measured cast timing.

title: Airborne → contact → recovery
source_label: STORYBOARD · jump ×2, grounded ×6 · no landing body exists in this manifest
observed: There is a jump cell and a grounded cell, but no land/compression row. Their source soles both register at the feet pivot; physical lift is separate.
proposal: On confirmed landing, plant both feet, bend fixed-length knees and lower the rigid torso; recover without adding a control lock. Do not recycle a one-foot walk pose as landing.
native_review: Distinguish airborne feet from ground contact at normal and reduced effects. Keep the receiving-surface shadow separate from the body.
runtime_gate: Jump/Float/air-dodge/wall exit/fast fall into landing; immediate re-jump, moving cast, platform or height changes, prediction correction and death.
asterisk: Precontact is an offline illustration only. Never predict a ground plant from a sprite, shadow or expected touchdown time.
